subject.title: fix(hooks): bound HOOK.md reads during hook install validation

question: Should hook package metadata require a stable, single-linked regular file in addition to the proposed 1 MiB size limit?
rationale: The OOM fix is sound, but the selected dependency primitive changes the accepted filesystem boundary beyond the behavior described and proven by the PR.

options.title: Adopt the full fs-safe contract
options.body: Keep `readRegularFile` and add or cite focused coverage confirming that symlinked and multiply linked hook metadata must be rejected consistently across install and workspace discovery.

options.title: Preserve linked-file compatibility
options.body: Use a bounded descriptor reader that limits bytes without rejecting currently supported linked metadata shapes.

recommendation.title: Adopt the full fs-safe contract
recommendation.body: Keep `readRegularFile` and add or cite focused coverage confirming that symlinked and multiply linked hook metadata must be rejected consistently across install and workspace discovery.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current resolver and own the strongest recent history across hook installation and hardened install flows.
